segments.text:
V. 15.
With deſire have I deſired—That is, I have earneſtly deſired it. He deſired it, both for the Sake of his Diſciples, to whom He deſired to manifeſt Himſelf farther, at this ſolemn Parting: And for the Sake of his whole Church, that He might inſtitute the grand Memorial of his Death.
